_comment: M11 filterable-KPI registry for the natural-language 'build me a KPI
Each entry's `sql` is a thin SELECT over one of the two dimensional
see sql/medallion.sql) with exactly one `{{where}}` placeholder,
substituted server-side by agent.dashboard.build_where() from an
allowlisted set of columns (`filter_columns` below) and validated,
quoted filter values only -- never raw user text. `filter_columns`
device/platform) to the actual column on THIS kpi's cube; a filter
dimension the cube does not carry (e.g. `platform` on a web-cube KPI)
is simply absent from the map and is silently not applied to that
one card -- it is still applied to every card whose cube has it.
Both cubes are DAY-grained (day_date) since the M11-fix -- date_start/
date_end always map to day_date, the finest grain a filter can be cut
at; dash_weekly_test_starts is the one KPI that still rolls day_date
UP to a week bucket in its own SELECT (a GROUP BY on top of the daily
cube), it just no longer relies on the cube itself being week-grained.
`chart`/`consent_note` follow the same shape as src/agent/metrics.yaml.

kpis.title: Funnel: starts, completions, store redirects
kpis.sql: SELECT 'test_starts' AS stage, 1 AS stage_order, SUM(test_starts) AS users FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} UNION ALL SELECT 'test_completes', 2, SUM(test_completes) FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} UNION ALL SELECT 'store_redirects', 3, SUM(store_redirects) FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} ORDER BY stage_order

kpis.title: Step-to-step conversion under this filter
kpis.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT SUM(test_starts) AS starts, SUM(test_completes) AS completes, SUM(store_redirects) AS redirects FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}}) SELECT 'start -> complete' AS step, 1 AS step_order, starts AS from_users, completes AS to_users, 1.0 * completes / NULLIF(starts, 0) AS conversion_rate FROM agg UNION ALL SELECT 'complete -> store redirect', 2, completes, redirects, 1.0 * redirects / NULLIF(completes, 0) FROM agg ORDER BY step_order

kpis.title: Completion rate by channel
kpis.sql: SELECT channel, SUM(test_starts) AS test_starts, SUM(test_completes) AS test_completes, 1.0 * SUM(test_completes) / NULLIF(SUM(test_starts), 0) AS completion_rate FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY channel ORDER BY completion_rate DESC

kpis.title: Completion rate by device
kpis.sql: SELECT device_category, SUM(test_starts) AS test_starts, SUM(test_completes) AS test_completes, 1.0 * SUM(test_completes) / NULLIF(SUM(test_starts), 0) AS completion_rate FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY device_category ORDER BY completion_rate DESC

kpis.title: Completion rate: channel x device
kpis.sql: SELECT channel, device_category, SUM(test_starts) AS test_starts, SUM(test_completes) AS test_completes, 1.0 * SUM(test_completes) / NULLIF(SUM(test_starts), 0) AS completion_rate FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY channel, device_category ORDER BY channel, device_category

kpis.title: Downloads by channel (bridge-linked)
kpis.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel AS channel, SUM(downloads) AS downloads FROM gold.journey_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY downloads DESC
kpis.consent_note: Only consented, signed-in, bridge-linked users appear here -- treat as a lower bound and a channel-mix signal, not absolute download volume.

kpis.title: Pairing rate by channel (bridge-linked)
kpis.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel AS channel, SUM(downloads) AS downloads, SUM(paired_users) AS paired_users, 1.0 * SUM(paired_users) / NULLIF(SUM(downloads), 0) AS pairing_rate FROM gold.journey_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY pairing_rate DESC
kpis.consent_note: Restricted to consented, signed-in, bridge-linked users; channels whose users consent less often are under-represented.

kpis.title: Pairing rate by platform x market (bridge-linked)
kpis.sql: SELECT market, platform, SUM(downloads) AS downloads, SUM(paired_users) AS paired_users, 1.0 * SUM(paired_users) / NULLIF(SUM(downloads), 0) AS pairing_rate FROM gold.journey_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY market, platform ORDER BY market, platform
kpis.consent_note: Market and platform are only known through the identity bridge, so this covers the linkable population, not every app device.

kpis.title: D30 retention by channel (bridge-linked)
kpis.sql: SELECT acquisition_channel AS channel, SUM(d30_eligible) AS eligible_users, SUM(d30_retained) AS retained_users, 1.0 * SUM(d30_retained) / NULLIF(SUM(d30_eligible), 0) AS d30_retention_rate FROM gold.journey_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY acquisition_channel ORDER BY d30_retention_rate DESC
kpis.consent_note: Bridge-linked, non-censored users only; retention of non-linkable or too-recently-acquired users is unobservable by design.

kpis.title: Weekly trend of test starts under this filter
kpis.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', day_date) AS week_start, SUM(test_starts) AS test_starts FROM gold.web_funnel_daily_cube WHERE {{where}} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
